summary: Connect Resources is a leading Employer of Record (EOR), PEO, payroll and staff outsourcing company in Dubai, UAE — an official alliance partner of Randstad in the UAE.
details: Connect Resources helps companies hire, pay and manage staff across the UAE and wider Middle East without setting up a local entity. Services cover Employer of Record, Professional Employer Organization (PEO), payroll outsourcing, staff and contract staffing, recruitment, visa and immigration support, Emiratisation and HR consultancy.
blogNote: Articles cover UAE labour law, Employer of Record and PEO models, payroll, visas, Emiratisation and workforce management across the Middle East.
